title: IT Risk Quantification Scenario
description: Schema for a single quantified IT risk scenario as used by the FAIR / Monte Carlo / LEC calculator in dashboard/engine.py. Foundation for scenario save/load (F8) and future STRIDE-import (Phase 3): a STRIDE threat model export should be mappable into one object per identified threat that validates against this schema.

name.description: Human-readable scenario name, e.g. 'Ransomware Attack (Medium Enterprise)'.

description.description: Free-text scenario description shown to the user (may include markdown emphasis).

currency.description: ISO-4217-style hint for which currency the monetary fields are expressed in.

lef.description: Loss Event Frequency — expected number of events per year.

lm.description: Loss Magnitude — average financial impact per event, in `currency` units.

lef_std.description: LEF uncertainty (standard deviation) used for Monte Carlo sampling of the normal-distributed frequency.

lm_std.description: LM uncertainty expressed as coefficient of variation (CV), used to parameterise the lognormal distribution for Monte Carlo sampling of loss magnitude.

control_cost.description: Annual cost of the proposed mitigating control, in `currency` units.

post_ale.description: Expected Annual Loss Expectancy after the control is applied (residual risk), in `currency` units.
